A useful reminder, mid-morning
A friendly watch is easier with a plan
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with pets should review their care arrangements before departure and keep travel papers ready for inspection. Clear planning helps the cabin team monitor animals in flight and keeps the journey orderly for all aboard.

The desk asks travelers to confirm crate fit, feeding needs, and comfort measures before check-in. If a traveler is uneasy about a pet's condition or handling, the supervisors will listen closely and guide the next step. <<FACT F012>> Please bring only approved carriers and secure all items that could shift during travel.

A careful plan also considers species, temperament, and rest needs. That approach supports calmer boarding, safer movement through the skyport, and steadier care after arrival. <<FACT F019>> If special attention is needed, tell the desk in plain terms so the record is complete and the crew can prepare without delay.

For guidance on pet travel paperwork, carrier checks, and boarding support, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
